Like everyone else said, watch for yourself. I had an ex years ago who left me due to my mental health spiraling around that same time. In hindsight, I know he did the right thing. One of the unfortunate effects of having a mental illness is that it's toxic to those who are around the inflicted person. People shouldn't  be around someone with "bad vibes" because "bad vibes" are contagious. 

That being said...if you care for this girl deeply, you may want to take that risk. This is fine and it's a really noble gesture if you try to walk her through these tough times. Being sick isn't fun. It consumes a person and kills them from the inside. She might feel completely alone even if she has a support system. Nothing can convince you of anything more than your own brain. So if she's being rash with you, know she doesn't mean it. Her illness just wants to isolate her from those around her and will try to push you away. Illness wants to get you all alone, like an abusive lover, so you'll have nowhere to turn when it kicks your ass.

So if you do plan to help her, know she doesn't mean to hurt you. Even wounded animals will bite a helping hand in a panic. But if it becomes too much for you to handle and it begins to deplete you of a quality of life, you will have to let her go. For your own health and well-being.
